name: reboards
title: ReBoards
description: Revamped agile boards: work with relations, group subtasks under their parent, use multiple swimlane levels and plan in time.
changeNotes:
Version 1.4.0:
- Add a Gantt layout: up to three planning levels from high-level to detailed (dates, date and period, single date, version or build), due dates, persons needed from the estimate, subtask trees and relation arrows.
- Reschedule in the Gantt layout by dragging bars, their edges or due dates, plan unscheduled issues by drawing on their row, and add a missing planning level with +; every change is confirmed before it is saved.
- Zoom the Gantt chart, fit it, or bring the selected issue or today into view with its floating controls; show or hide planning levels with the chips in its header; navigate it with the keyboard.
- One Time & planning setup for the time and Gantt layouts; time setups from 1.3.0 are converted automatically.
- Time rows per sprint, day, week, month or quarter, with the issue count, work and persons needed per row; cards show their due date, and timing highlights follow the plans and due dates of the Gantt layout.
- C and Shift+C collapse or expand one level of subtasks.
- The toolbar fits narrow windows; the Show menu is now the ⋯ menu.
- Support float fields.
